rules.title: No harassment or personal attacks
rules.description: Insulting, demeaning, or targeting another member with hostile language, including slurs, threats, or sustained mockery.

rules.title: No hate speech or discriminatory language
rules.description: Slurs or attacks based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or similar protected characteristics.

rules.title: No threats of violence or harm
rules.description: Threatening to hurt someone, dox them, or otherwise cause real-world harm.

rules.title: No spam or unsolicited advertising
rules.description: Repeated posting of the same content, invite links to other servers, or advertising unrelated products and services without permission.

rules.title: No NSFW content
rules.description: Sexually explicit content, gore, or shock material anywhere in the server.

rules.title: No sharing private information
rules.description: Posting someone's real name, address, phone number, workplace, or other personal information without consent.
